cases.case: Observed window A destroyed; later B receives recycled HWND H
cases.requiredOutcome: A `destroyed`; B gets new window/native incarnation; old A mutation rejected

cases.case: Cold gap spans possible HWND H destruction/reuse
cases.requiredOutcome: no exact rebound from H alone; result stale/ambiguous unless stronger lineage exists

cases.case: Two concurrent windows share title, class, geometry and appearance
cases.requiredOutcome: distinct only by exact generation/owner/app evidence; weak lookup ambiguous

cases.case: Exact incumbent operation causes documented HWND recreation
cases.requiredOutcome: same `window_*` only when operation/strong lineage proves transition; new native incarnation

cases.case: Unobserved recreation yields same title/class/geometry
cases.requiredOutcome: no exact continuity; stale/ambiguous

cases.case: Genuine application restart resembles prior run
cases.requiredOutcome: same `app_*`, new `appinst_*`, all descendant mutations through old IDs rejected

cases.case: Native parent/owner is destroyed and replaced
cases.requiredOutcome: descendant bindings stale/destroyed; no reparent-by-similarity

cases.case: Dialog A closes; identical dialog B opens
cases.requiredOutcome: old A/OK rejected; B untouched

cases.case: Two identical dialogs exist simultaneously
cases.requiredOutcome: exact owner/generation keeps distinct or target is ambiguous; no guessed action

cases.case: Modal dialog disables parent
cases.requiredOutcome: parent controls report `modal_blocked`; mutation refused until modal closes

cases.case: Unexpected popup/flyout appears outside retained UIA subtree
cases.requiredOutcome: session-wide native signal triggers scoped discovery; popup represented without global mirror

cases.case: Sibling controls have duplicate visible names
cases.requiredOutcome: name lookup ambiguous; retained exact target not switched

cases.case: Target has no AutomationId
cases.requiredOutcome: other evidence may retain same-epoch incumbent; no fabricated durable identity

cases.case: Siblings have duplicate AutomationId
cases.requiredOutcome: AutomationId lookup ambiguous; exact mutation refused

cases.case: Replacement control reuses AutomationId
cases.requiredOutcome: old control stale/destroyed; replacement new; no AutomationId rebound alone

cases.case: Provider reconstructs same element with a changed RuntimeId
cases.requiredOutcome: exact rebound only with stronger exact witness; otherwise stale/candidate

cases.case: RuntimeId/slug-like witness is reused after provider replacement
cases.requiredOutcome: old retained object never maps to replacement from RuntimeId alone

cases.case: Live UIA reference returns `UIA_E_ELEMENTNOTAVAILABLE`
cases.requiredOutcome: binding invalidated; realize only if virtual-item contract applies; no blind retry

cases.case: Control destroyed/recreated with identical properties
cases.requiredOutcome: old control rejected; replacement new

cases.case: Exact parent subtree is recreated
cases.requiredOutcome: descendants stale unless independently strong keyed reconstruction under exact new parent is justified

cases.case: Same HWND navigates to a replacement semantic page
cases.requiredOutcome: window may remain; old page controls stale; no tree-path rebound

cases.case: Exact target becomes disabled before semantic call
cases.requiredOutcome: no mutation; typed `disabled`/state result

cases.case: Exact target disappears between resolution and semantic call
cases.requiredOutcome: no fallback target; typed stale/unavailable result

cases.case: UIA/WinEvent signal is missing, duplicated, late or reordered
cases.requiredOutcome: event only marks dirty; scoped current query establishes truth; no false delta history

cases.case: Primary killer: A's recycled container E now represents duplicate-looking B
cases.requiredOutcome: old A action never touches B; keyed A reacquired or stale/virtualized/ambiguous

cases.case: Keyed item changes index after sort
cases.requiredOutcome: same `item_*`, new representation/view epoch, action reaches keyed item

cases.case: Keyed item filtered out then restored
cases.requiredOutcome: same logical item may be virtualized/unrepresented, then reacquired by key

cases.case: Unkeyed duplicate rows reorder after sort/filter
cases.requiredOutcome: no durable item continuity; old row target ambiguous/stale

cases.case: Virtual placeholder invalidated by another `FindItemByProperty`/viewport change
cases.requiredOutcome: old placeholder not used; re-find by durable key or return virtualized/stale

cases.case: `Realize` changes viewport/container materialization
cases.requiredOutcome: item key remains authority; representation revision advances; no container identity

cases.case: Provider exposes selection only for viewport items
cases.requiredOutcome: selection result states scope/partiality and reconciles keyed selected item where supportable

cases.case: Tree node collapse destroys/virtualizes descendants
cases.requiredOutcome: descendants virtualized/stale; no positional rebound on re-expand

cases.case: Pointer target moves before final check
cases.requiredOutcome: abort `target_moved`; zero click mutation

cases.case: Destructive overlay appears before final check
cases.requiredOutcome: hit/overlay mismatch aborts; underlying/overlay targets untouched

cases.case: UIA and native hit tests disagree or child is windowless
cases.requiredOutcome: no raw click unless route-specific evidence resolves disagreement; otherwise abort

cases.case: DPI/display topology/virtual origin changes after point computation
cases.requiredOutcome: display epoch mismatch aborts stale-coordinate action

cases.case: Target is minimized, cloaked, offscreen or materially occluded
cases.requiredOutcome: state remains distinct; pointer path refused unless current interactability is proven

cases.case: Focus thief activates B before final keyboard preflight
cases.requiredOutcome: `focus_mismatch`; no text reaches B

cases.case: Windows denies foreground transfer
cases.requiredOutcome: `foreground_denied`; no key/pointer injection

cases.case: foreground, active, native focus and UIA focus disagree during transition
cases.requiredOutcome: no typing until declared target focus predicate is current; otherwise abort

cases.case: Modifier state/Unicode path plus deterministic post-preflight focus barrier
cases.requiredOutcome: smallest batch and postcondition measured; wrong recipient is a failure, assurance remains race-bounded

cases.case: UIA worker/provider restarts while app stays
cases.requiredOutcome: provider epoch advances; only strong exact reconstructions rebound; no weak mutation replay

cases.case: Cold recovery with no change and strong app/control/item keys
cases.requiredOutcome: exact supported concepts `rebound_exact` with evidence; cursor gap remains explicit

cases.case: Cold gap: A destroyed, indistinguishable B created
cases.requiredOutcome: A never exact-rebounds; B is candidate/new concept; old mutation rejected

cases.case: Delta cursor expires and events are intentionally dropped
cases.requiredOutcome: explicit `gap`; scoped sync/resnapshot; no silent continuity

cases.case: One provider call blocks beyond deadline
cases.requiredOutcome: worker recycled; kernel and other app scopes responsive; no mutation replay

cases.case: Session locks or input desktop switches during pending work
cases.requiredOutcome: desktop epoch advances; physical work refused; semantic availability reported honestly

cases.case: Capture is protected/blank/unavailable or accessible value is protected
cases.requiredOutcome: explicit protected/unavailable result; no OCR/value fabrication

cases.case: Visual-only target is moving or multiple visual candidates are equally valid
cases.requiredOutcome: current visual revision/uniqueness required; otherwise pointer action refused

cases.case: `appinst_*` has multiple plausible SHELLeye cohorts or browser/window correlations
cases.requiredOutcome: sparse link remains ambiguous; target-bound cross-substrate action refused
